sample_text: Carefully written tickets help you as an operator in completing toll calls. Sometimes, for example, you cannot advance a call immediately because all trunks are busy. If your attention is then required by other work, such as making a timely entry on another connection, you can make sure of the called number later by reading it from the ticket. And of course, you need an accurate and legible ticket to make another attempt on a delayed call.
source: Bell System training film, Operating Technique, "A" Board Toll Tickets, year unknown; Connections Museum YouTube, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H8G4E1qmFdo, 0:50 to 1:25
